model_parameters.coefficient_semantics: two primitive-center classes; ordered cubic site-star monomials and normalization fixed by the bound source and energy identity
model_parameters.role: exact energy parameters used for this declared research trajectory

basis.energy_coefficient_convention: K*d_p*d_q*d_r divided by repeated-coordinate factorials; p<=q<=r
basis.metric: unweighted full ordered physical Cartesian FC3 Frobenius norm

fit.gauge: zero-initialized unregularized minimum Euclidean coefficient norm at convergence; bounded iteration approximate

fit_geometry.coordinate_order: lexicographic Cartesian bond vectors rounded to10decimals; original vectors retained
fit_geometry.minimum_image_algorithm: bounded exact integer-image enumeration using smallest lattice singular value

material.fit_coordinates: physical Cartesian displacement differences before mass normalization
